_comment: Pointer-up commits clone — sets parentHubId on the clone to draggingNearestHubId, updates caption/subtype, clears drag state. Depends on EBR2-F-03 (cloneNode + draggingNodeId) and EBR2-F-04 (drag listener computes nearestHubId).

steps.js: (() => { const set = window.__PRISM_EDITOR_SET_VIEW_MODE__; if (typeof set === 'function') set('canvas'); return 'canvas'; })()

(() => { const stores = window.__PRISM_DEBUG_STORES__; const ed = stores.graphEditor.getState(); const src = stores.graphSource.getState(); const node = src.nodes[0]; ed.selectNode(node.nodeId); ed.setEditorMode('edit'); src.cloneNode(node.nodeId); window.__EBR2_F_05_CLONE_ID__ = ed.draggingNodeId; return ed.draggingNodeId; })()

(() => { const canvas = document.querySelector('canvas'); const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect(); const tx = rect.left + rect.width * 0.7; const ty = rect.top + rect.height * 0.5; canvas.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointermove', { clientX: tx, clientY: ty, bubbles: true, pointerId: 1 })); return { tx, ty }; })()

(() => { const canvas = document.querySelector('canvas'); const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect(); const tx = rect.left + rect.width * 0.7; const ty = rect.top + rect.height * 0.5; canvas.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerup', { clientX: tx, clientY: ty, bubbles: true, pointerId: 1 })); return true; })()

(() => { const stores = window.__PRISM_DEBUG_STORES__; const ed = stores.graphEditor.getState(); const src = stores.graphSource.getState(); const cloneId = window.__EBR2_F_05_CLONE_ID__; if (!cloneId) return false; const clone = src.nodes.find((n) => n.nodeId === cloneId); return ed.draggingNodeId === null && !!clone && typeof clone.parentHubId === 'string' && clone.parentHubId.length > 0; })()
